name: hh-meanrev-micro: RSI capitulation bounce, liquid majors (15m)
rationale: MECHANISM: an RSI deep-oversold print marks short-term SELLER EXHAUSTION — the marginal panic seller is done and the resting bid ladder (makers, dip-buyers) lifts price back toward VWAP. The other side is the late/emotional retail seller dumping at the bottom; the persistence is behavioral (fear-selling clusters) but only HARVESTABLE where costs are thin. This is the fee-realist cut of the family: the same capitulation trigger, deliberately restricted to the MOST liquid pairs (BTC/ETH-class) where the round-trip taker cost is low enough that a genuine bounce survives fees, gated by the venue min_liquidity so the universe selector excludes thin alts. Entry: rsi deeply oversold AND bb_z confirming the extreme. Long-only spot; short hold; exit as rsi recovers. DISCONFIRMER: this dies on illiquid alts — if net PnL is positive on majors but the SAME rule is negative on the alt basket, the edge is a fee-arb not a signal. Even on majors it is thin: require the majors net-Sharpe to clear a real bar AFTER fees, not just gross. If it fails to beat buy-and-hold on majors (bounces underperform simply holding through the dip), kill — the snapback was smaller than the trend it interrupted.
catalyst: RSI capitulation bounce restricted to the most liquid pairs where fees are thin
